package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path"
	"path/filepath"

	"github.com/sumdahl/omaphoenix/internal/category"
	"github.com/sumdahl/omaphoenix/internal/core"
	"github.com/sumdahl/omaphoenix/internal/selection"
)

func write(dir, name string, v any) {
	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(v, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name), append(b, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

func main() {
	out := os.Args[1]
	man := filepath.Join(out, "manifest")
	sel := filepath.Join(out, "selection")
	os.MkdirAll(man, 0o755)
	os.MkdirAll(sel, 0o755)

	write(man, "full.json", core.Manifest{
		Format: core.Format, OmarchyVersion: "4.0.4-1", Host: "latitude", Hardware: "Dell Inc. Latitude 7430",
		User: "u", Shell: "/usr/bin/zsh",
		Items: map[string][]category.Item{
			"pkg-repo": {{ID: "btop"}, {ID: "zsh"}},
			"plugin":   {{ID: "media", Note: "https://github.com/sumdahl/media@3f2a1c9"}},
			"config":   {{ID: ".config/hypr/bindings.lua"}, {ID: ".zshrc"}, {ID: "a<b>&c \"q\" ünï"}},
			"secret":   {{ID: ".ssh/id_ed25519", Note: "encrypted"}},
			"etc":      {},
		},
	})
	write(man, "minimal.json", core.Manifest{Format: core.Format, Items: map[string][]category.Item{}})
	write(man, "nil-items.json", core.Manifest{Format: core.Format, OmarchyVersion: "4.0.3-2", Host: "h", User: "u", Shell: "/bin/bash"})

	patterns := []string{"*", "", "a", "a*", "*a", "a*b", "a?c", "?", "*/*", ".config/*", ".config/*/*", ".config/hypr/*.lua",
		"[abc]", "[a-c]x", "[^a]", "[!a]", "[]a]", "[a-]", "[", "[a", "a[", "\\*", "\\", "a\\", "\\[x", "*\\*", "[\\]]", "[\\-]",
		"ü?", "?ï", "[ü-ÿ]", "**", "a**b", "*.lua", "x*y*z", "*/", "/*", ".z*", "a/b", "a/*b", "*b*"}
	names := []string{"", "a", "b", "abc", "ab", "aXb", "a/b", "a/xb", "acx", "bx", ".config", ".config/hypr", ".config/hypr/bindings.lua",
		".config/hypr/x/y.lua", "*", "[x", "a*b", "a\\", "ü", "üb", "xyz", "xaybz", "x/y/z", "/a", "]", "-", "ï", ".zshrc", "a[", "\\"}
	type matchCase struct {
		Pattern, Name string
		Match, BadPattern bool
	}
	var matches []matchCase
	for _, p := range patterns {
		for _, n := range names {
			ok, err := path.Match(p, n)
			matches = append(matches, matchCase{p, n, ok, err != nil})
		}
	}
	write(sel, "path-match.json", matches)

	ruleSets := map[string]string{
		"default":  selection.Default,
		"excludes": "config:*\n!config:.config/chromium\n!config:.config/hypr/*\nconfig:.config/hypr/bindings.lua\n",
		"comments": "  # header\nplugin:*   # all plugins\n\n!plugin:weather\r\nbroken line without colon\n!theme:*\ntheme:a\n",
		"order":    "bin:x\n!bin:*\nbin:y\n",
		"machine":  "config:*\nmachine:config:.config/hypr/monitors.lua\nmachine:etc:/etc/tlp.conf\n!machine:config:x\nmachine:bad\n",
		"escaped":  "config:*\n!config:a\\*b\n!config:\\[x\n!config:a\\\\\n",
		"hash":     "config:*\n!config:#emacs#\n",
		"empty":    "",
	}
	ids := map[string][]string{
		"pkg-repo": {"zsh", "btop"}, "plugin": {"weather", "media"}, "theme": {"a", "b"},
		"config":   {".config/chromium", ".config/hypr/bindings.lua", ".config/hypr/monitors.lua", ".config/hypr", ".zshrc", "a*b", "aXb", "[x", "x", "a\\", "#emacs#", ""},
		"bin":      {"x", "y", "z"}, "secret": {".ssh/id_ed25519"}, "machine": {"config"},
	}
	type selCase struct {
		Rules, Category, ID string
		Selected            bool
	}
	type ruleSet struct {
		Name, Text string
		Machine    map[string][]string
		Cases      []selCase
	}
	var sets []ruleSet
	for name, text := range ruleSets {
		r := selection.Parse(text)
		rs := ruleSet{Name: name, Text: text, Machine: r.Machine()}
		for cat, list := range ids {
			for _, id := range list {
				rs.Cases = append(rs.Cases, selCase{name, cat, id, r.Selected(cat, id)})
			}
		}
		sets = append(sets, rs)
	}
	write(sel, "selected.json", sets)

	type buildCase struct {
		Choices []selection.Choice
		Output  string
	}
	var builds []buildCase
	for _, cs := range [][]selection.Choice{
		{},
		{{Category: "plugin", IDs: []string{"media", "weather"}, Selected: []bool{true, false}}},
		{{Category: "config", IDs: []string{"a*b", "[x", "a\\", "q?"}, Selected: []bool{false, false, true, false}}},
		{{Category: "theme", IDs: []string{"a", "b"}, Selected: []bool{false, false}}, {Category: "bin", IDs: nil, Selected: nil}},
		{{Category: "secret", IDs: []string{".ssh/id_ed25519", ".ssh/id_rsa", "tok*"}, Selected: []bool{true, false, true}}},
		{{Category: "secret", IDs: []string{"k"}, Selected: []bool{false}}},
	} {
		builds = append(builds, buildCase{cs, selection.Build(cs)})
	}
	write(sel, "build.json", builds)
	os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(sel, "default.conf"), []byte(selection.Default), 0o644)
}
